name: Seis pelo Japão
description: A private trip-planning app for six travellers heading to Japan this winter. Washi paper, five inks and station-style stamps that get inked as things happen. Hidden preference votes, a ranked ballot over four routes, a route builder that enforces twenty nights and New Year closures, shared expenses in yen, an offline notebook, and a Today screen with the hotel address in Japanese for taxi drivers. Portuguese UI, English place names.

name: Viagem África do Sul
description: The family's South Africa trip planner, and the prototype for everything the Japan app does better. Private repository, Portuguese throughout.
